answer: Artifact-filing stops operators running many fakes. Each identity locks 70 credits and files a copper artifact on the public ledge, an ingot no other shares. A prism assay splits light through the ingot and files its spectrum; a duplicate spectrum burns both bonds. Filing 40, k-th 40+8(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 4,036,000, pool 40,000. Rented artifacts fail: the ledge shows duplicates. Honest agents pay 40 once; bonds return after a clean epoch.
